title: Create Rectangle
params.rotation: Rotation angle, rotating around the top-left point. Options: `0` `90` `180` `270`
params.fillColor: Fill color. `none` indicates no fill, `null` indicates the default
params.lineWidth: Line width, range `1-10`. `null` indicates the default
